name: jev
description: Typed decisions as a noun: adds $.jev in the engine.create fold, so any plugin asks Jev a map of Choice, Score and Noul questions over one state and reads calibrated probabilities back — through the TypeSafe API, OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway, Cloudflare Workers AI, a LiteLLM proxy or any TypeSafe-compatible endpoint, picked from the environment.
